mapper.sql: select r.response_id, r.survey_id, r.user_id, r.submitted_at, s.title as survey_title, u.user_name from wjdc_survey_response r left join wjdc_survey s on r.survey_id = s.id left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select r.response_id, r.survey_id, r.user_id, r.submitted_at, s.title as survey_title, u.user_name, a.answer_id, a.question_id, a.answer_text, q.question_title, q.question_type, case when q.question_type in ('1', '2') then (select GROUP_CONCAT(opt.option_text ORDER BY opt.sort_order SEPARATOR '; ') from wjdc_survey_option opt where opt.question_id = q.id and ( FIND_IN_SET(opt.id, a.answer_text) > 0 or a.answer_text = opt.id )) else a.answer_text end as option_text from wjdc_survey_response r left join wjdc_survey s on r.survey_id = s.id left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id left join wjdc_survey_answer a on r.response_id = a.response_id left join wjdc_survey_question q on a.question_id = q.id where r.response_id = #{responseId} order by q.sort_order
mapper.insert:
insert into wjdc_survey_response
survey_id, user_id, submitted_at,
#{surveyId}, #{userId}, #{submittedAt},
mapper.delete:
delete from wjdc_survey_response where response_id in
#{responseId}
